| 1024 (0x0400) | `common_hello_parameters` | `hold_time`, `t`, `r`, `g`, `reserved` |   |
| 1025 (0x0401) | `ipv4_transport_address` | `address` |   |
| 1026 (0x0402) | `configuration_sequence_number` | `sequence_number` |   |
| 1027 (0x0403) | `ipv6_transport_address` | `address` |   |
| 1280 (0x0500) | `common_session_parameters` | `protocol_version`, `keepalive_time`, `a`, `d`, `reserved`, `pv_lim`, `max_pdu_length`, `receiver_lsr_id`, `receiver_label_space` |   |
